GU_ZHEN_REN_RUBILD_RECIPE_COMPENDIUM.des: Browse the Gu compendium plus every refinement and killer-move recipe, with each Gu's acquisition and paths.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RUBILD_CARDPILE_GU_ACTIVE.de: Holds up to 5 Gu ready to activate. Empty slots are filled from Gu Waiting in order.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RUBILD_CARDPILE_GU_STORAGE.d: Holds recovered Gu waiting for an active slot.
Gu with no uses left recover here, then join the waiting queue.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RUBILD_CARDPILE_GU_SEALED.de: Gu materials sealed by a killer move wait here. While sealed they take no refill, recovery, or derivation slots; when the killer move finishes they return to Gu Recovery with a full cooldown.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RUBILD_SHA_ZHAO.targetSelect: First choose the killer move to derive. Only materials that match it will be shown next.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RUBILD_SHA_ZHAO.selectionPro: Choose the Gu materials that match {TargetName}, then confirm.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RUBILD_SHA_ZHAO.noRecipe: No killer move can be derived from the Gu in your Active Gu or Gu Waiting piles. Nothing was spent.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RUBILD_SHA_ZHAO.notEnoughMat: Not enough matching materials are available. Nothing was spent; the selected Gu stay in their piles.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RUBILD_SHA_ZHAO.invalidRecip: These materials do not form a killer move. Nothing was spent; the selected Gu stay in their piles.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RUBILD_SHA_ZHAO.insufficient: Not enough Yuan Qi. Nothing was spent; the selected Gu stay in their piles.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RUBILD_SHA_ZHAO.creationFail: The current combat state cannot create the killer move. Nothing was spent; the selected Gu stay in their piles.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RUBILD_SHA_ZHAO.handFull: Your hand is full, so the derived killer move cannot be added. Nothing was spent; the selected Gu stay in their piles.
GU_ZHEN_REN_RUBILD_SECONDARY_RESOURCE_YU: A separate combat resource spent to activate Gu. Refilled on the first turn of each combat; afterwards it restores every turn by aperture rank. Ranks 1-9: capacity 3/4/4/5/5/6/6/6/6, recovery 1/2/2/2/2/3/3/3/3; it stops growing once the aperture turns immortal at rank 6.
